column3: Prompt
Write 10 Etsy listing titles for [PRODUCT] aimed at [BUYER], each under 140 characters, front-loading the two most-searched phrases, no repeated words, no ALL CAPS.
Rewrite this title so the first 40 characters carry the strongest keyword and the rest adds material, size and use case: [TITLE]. Give 5 variants.
List 25 long-tail search phrases a buyer might type when looking for [PRODUCT] as a gift for [OCCASION]. Group them by intent: gift, personal use, bulk.
Take these three competitor titles and produce one better title that avoids their exact phrasing but covers the same searches: [TITLE 1] / [TITLE 2] / [TITLE 3].
Suggest 8 title formulas for a shop that sells [CATEGORY], with a filled example for each formula.
Audit this title for keyword stuffing and readability, then give a cleaner version that keeps the top three phrases: [TITLE].
Write titles for the same [PRODUCT] in three sizes/variants so they do not compete with each other in search: [VARIANTS].
Give me 10 seasonal title variations for [PRODUCT] for [HOLIDAY], to run only during that window.
Which of these titles would you click first as a buyer, and why: [TITLES]. Rank them.
Turn this plain description of what I make into an Etsy title a real buyer would search for: [DESCRIPTION].

Write an Etsy description for [PRODUCT]: opening line that repeats the main keyword naturally, 3 short benefit bullets, materials and dimensions, how it ships, a care note, and a one-line personalization instruction. Under 250 words.
Rewrite this description in a warm, plain voice with no marketing clichés, keeping every fact: [DESCRIPTION].
Write the first 160 characters of a description for [PRODUCT] so it reads well as the search snippet and includes [KEYWORD].
Draft a 'What you get' section for a digital download of [PRODUCT]: file formats, sizes, what software opens it, what is NOT included, and a line about no physical item being shipped.
Write a personalization section that tells buyers exactly what to enter in the personalization box for [PRODUCT], with two examples and a character limit.
Create a materials and dimensions block for [PRODUCT] in the format Etsy buyers expect, using both inches and centimeters.
Write 5 FAQ entries for [PRODUCT] covering sizing, shipping time, returns, custom orders and care, in the buyer's words.
Turn these customer questions from my messages into an FAQ section: [QUESTIONS].
Write a gift-focused paragraph for [PRODUCT] for [RECIPIENT], mentioning gift wrap and a note option if I offer them: [YES/NO].
Rewrite my description so a screen reader would describe the product clearly (alt-text style clarity), then give me matching alt text for 5 photos.
Write a description for a made-to-order item with a [N]-day production time that sets expectations kindly and clearly.
Condense this description to 120 words without losing materials, size or shipping info: [DESCRIPTION].
Give me exactly 13 Etsy tags for [PRODUCT], each 20 characters or fewer, multi-word phrases, no words already in the title, covering style, occasion, recipient, material and use.
Here is my title and current tags. Find overlaps and replace the redundant tags with new search angles: [TITLE] / [TAGS].
Produce 13 tags for the same [PRODUCT] under three different buyer intents: gifting, home decor, and collector. Three lists.
Suggest which Etsy attributes (color, material, occasion, holiday, style) fit [PRODUCT], and which to leave blank.
List 20 adjacent niches whose buyers might also want [PRODUCT], with one tag idea for each.
Convert these 40 keyword ideas into the best 13 tags, explaining the two you dropped and why: [KEYWORDS].
Write 13 tags for a [HOLIDAY] version of [PRODUCT], to swap in six weeks before the holiday.
Give me tags for [PRODUCT] in British and American spelling variants where it matters.

Write a shot list of 10 photos for [PRODUCT]: hero on white, in use, scale reference, detail, packaging, variants, size chart graphic, lifestyle, flat lay, and a text overlay slide. For each: angle, light, prop, and what the buyer should learn.
Describe a 10-second Etsy listing video for [PRODUCT] shot on a phone, frame by frame, that shows scale and texture.
Suggest 6 text overlays for listing images that answer the top buyer objections for [PRODUCT].
Give me a simple lighting setup for photographing [PRODUCT] near a window, with what to avoid.
Write an infographic image brief that shows the sizes of [PRODUCT] against everyday objects.
Plan a 5-image sequence for a digital product ([PRODUCT]) that shows the file on screen, printed, and in use, so buyers understand what they get.
Write a friendly reply to a buyer asking if [PRODUCT] will arrive by [DATE], when my production time is [N] days and shipping is [N] days. Offer an upgrade if available.
Draft a message to a buyer whose order is delayed at the carrier, with the tracking link placeholder, an apology that does not over-promise, and next steps.
Write a polite reply declining a custom request I cannot do, with an alternative from my shop.
Write a thank-you note to include with orders of [PRODUCT], 40 words, no request for reviews in the note itself.
Draft a message asking for a review 5 days after delivery, short and low-pressure, with an easy out.
Reply to a 3-star review that says [REVIEW], publicly, in two sentences, without arguing.
Write a message to a buyer who entered personalization text with a typo: confirm before I make it.
Write a message for a buyer who wants to return a personalized item, explaining my policy kindly and offering a partial fix if possible.
Draft 5 canned replies I can save in Etsy Messages for: shipping time, sizing, custom orders, wholesale, and 'is it in stock'.
Write a gentle follow-up to a buyer who has not responded to my question about their order in 3 days, mentioning I will ship the default if I do not hear back by [DATE].
I sell [PRODUCTS] at [PRICES]. Suggest 5 bundles or variants that raise average order value without new materials.
Give me a 30-day plan to reach my first 10 sales in a new shop selling [PRODUCT], one action per day, no paid ads.
Estimate a price for [PRODUCT] given materials cost [X], time [Y] hours, and Etsy fees (6.5% transaction, 3% + $0.25 payment, $0.20 listing). Show the math at three margins.
Compare running an Etsy sale versus a coupon versus free shipping for [PRODUCT] and tell me which one to try first and why.
Write my shop announcement (under 160 characters) and my About section (150 words) for a shop that makes [PRODUCT] in [PLACE].
Suggest 10 shop section names for a shop that sells [PRODUCTS], ordered the way a buyer would browse.
List the 8 most common reasons a new Etsy listing gets no views and a fix for each.
Draft a weekly 30-minute routine for maintaining my shop: what to check, renew, and update.
Plan my listings for the next 3 months around these holidays: [HOLIDAYS]. When to list, when to promote, when to pull.
Write a policies section: processing time, shipping, returns for digital vs physical, and custom orders, in plain language.
I have [N] listings and [M] sales. Ask me 10 diagnostic questions to find what to fix first.
Suggest 5 low-cost product ideas adjacent to [PRODUCT] that use the same materials and skills, with the buyer for each.
Write a listing description for a printable [PRODUCT] that explains sizes included, paper suggestions, how to print at home or at a print shop, and the personal-use license.
Write the license text for a digital download: personal use, no resale, no redistribution, in 80 plain words.
Create a one-page 'How to download your files from Etsy' guide to include as a PDF, covering desktop and the app.
Suggest 10 file bundle ideas for a shop selling [DIGITAL PRODUCT] that raise value without much extra work.
Write a message template for buyers who cannot open [FILE TYPE], with the free apps that open it on Mac, Windows, iPhone and Android.
Turn this spreadsheet template idea into a listing: [IDEA]. Name, subtitle, what it tracks, who it is for, and 5 bullets.
Write 5 Pinterest pin titles and descriptions for [PRODUCT], each with a keyword and a reason to click.
Draft a 3-post Instagram sequence introducing [PRODUCT]: behind the scenes, the product, and a customer use. Include first-line hooks.
Write 6 short-form video hooks (under 8 words) for [PRODUCT].
Give me an Etsy Ads plan for a $3/day budget: which listings to include, when to check, and what numbers mean stop or scale.
Write a short pitch to a local gift shop asking to stock [PRODUCT], with wholesale pricing at [X].
Create 5 caption templates I can reuse weekly for a shop that sells [PRODUCTS].
Summarize these 20 reviews into the top 3 praised things and top 2 complaints, and suggest a listing change for each complaint: [REVIEWS].
Write a public response to a 1-star review that is about shipping delay outside my control, calm and factual.
Draft a message to a happy buyer asking permission to feature their photo in my listing.
Suggest 5 small packaging touches that reliably earn 5-star mentions, for [PRODUCT].
I will paste 10 product names. For each, give a title (under 140 chars), 13 tags, and a 2-sentence opener. Format as a table: [PRODUCTS].
Here are my 5 best-selling listings. Find the pattern in their titles and tags and apply it to these 5 weak listings: [BEST] / [WEAK].
Rewrite all of these descriptions in one consistent voice, keeping facts unchanged: [DESCRIPTIONS].
Generate a CSV with columns title, description, tags for these products so I can copy into listings: [PRODUCTS].
